text:
Maria Chen: Hey team — got invoice from NovaCloud (INV-2026-881) that landed in AP today. No PO on the header and vendor charged sales tax that wasn’t in the quote. System rejected it when matching to PO. Can someone help route or approve an exception?

Ashok Patel: Can you paste the invoice image or key lines? vendor name + tax amount + any reference numbers. I can check if a PO exists under a different vendor alias.

Maria Chen: Pasting the header they sent:
```
Invoice: INV-2026-881
Vendor: NovaCloud Inc.
Date: 2026-02-20
Total: $14,820.00
Tax: $1,120.00
PO#: (blank)
Notes: subscription renewal - Redwood inference prod usage Feb 2026
```
No PO field at all. Vendor emailed saying they couldn't attach our PO because their billing system stripped the field. :facepalm:

Sarah Gomez: AP system will hold — missing PO required for automated routing. If we approve manually we need GL and cost center splits. Also need the vendor W9 matched in file vault.

Priya Nair: I can take this as an invoice-exception. Quick Q: how should cost be allocated across teams? Vendor mentions multi-product usage. If we split, we need percent splits + GL codes. Also tagging for tax — is the tax charge valid? Were we tax-exempt in that jurisdiction?

Lee Park: This should be split 60/40 ENG infra / ML platform. 60% to GL 5401 (eng-run), 40% to GL 5422 (ml-platform). Use cost centers ENG-001 and ML-023.

Maria Chen: Confirmed — vendor says the tax is state sales tax for CA where they have nexus. We don't have a tax-exempt certificate on file for them. Tax looks accurate per their explanation.

Ashok Patel: I'll see if there is any existing PO that could be retrofitted. If not, procurement prefers creating a PO amendment referencing the subscription and routing to Priya for sign-off. That way AP can tie it.

approvals-bot: Reminder: invoice-exception queue has pending items >3 days. Manual approvals need two finance approvers if >$10k.

Priya Nair: Thanks @approvals-bot — note on policy: manual exceptions above $10k need a secondary approver (Head of Finance). /cc @Sarah Gomez for final payment release. I can approve the exception once procurement creates the PO record and we attach the vendor email and W9.

Sarah Gomez: I'll hold a tentative payment hold. Please attach: vendor W9, vendor billing contact, the email trail, and the PO id once created. Also add the suggested GL splits into the invoice metadata so AP can post correctly.

Maria Chen: Uploading attachments to the thread: vendor_email-thread.pdf (uploaded), vendor_w9.pdf (uploaded).

Ashok Patel: Procurement created PO PO-2026-1129 — it's a retro PO referencing subscription period Feb 2026. I linked it in the procurement system. Can someone confirm and I'll add the PO number to the AP ticket.

Priya Nair: I reviewed PO-2026-1129. Good. Maria, please add the PO# (PO-2026-1129) to the invoice record in AP and confirm GL split as Lee specified. Once done I will sign the manual exception.

Maria Chen: Done — invoice record updated with PO-2026-1129 and cost split 60/40, GLs and cost centers attached. Ready for Priya. :white_check_mark:

Priya Nair: Approved the exception and routed to Head of Finance for secondary sign-off.

Sarah Gomez: Head of Finance signed off, releasing AP payment. Scheduled payment date 2026-03-02. Will confirm when paid.

Lee Park: Thanks everyone. Quick ask: can procurement add a note to vendor onboarding to ensure PO# field is preserved on future invoices? We've seen this before.

Ashok Patel: Noted — adding a validation step to vendor billing checklist and reaching out to NovaCloud to ask they include our PO in the PDF body (or in the email subject) to avoid truncation.

Maria Chen: Awesome, appreciate the quick turnaround. Closing this thread once payment confirms. :tada:
